item.title: 💬 Constructive dialogue Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasiliy Osmakov held a working meeting with the Minister of Defence of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Ahmed Fiqi, on the s
item.description: Constructive dialogue Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasiliy Osmakov held a working meeting with the Minister of Defence of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Ahmed Fiqi, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit. 💬 The sides discussed the prospects for developing bilateral military cooperation and exchanged views on approaches to implementing joint initiatives in the field of regional and global security. ✅ The priority areas of interdepartmental cooperation were determined as improving the regulatory framework, training national servicemen and exchanging experience in the spheres of greatest interest, above all in combating terrorism and piracy. 🤝 The meeting was held in a friendly spirit and confirmed the mutual interest in strengthening Russian-Somali military ties. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30331

Constructive dialogue
Russian Deputy Defence Minister Vasiliy Osmakov held a working meeting with the Minister of Defence of the Federal Republic of Somalia, Ahmed Fiqi, on the sidelines of the third Russia-Africa Summit.
💬
The sides discussed the prospects for developing bilateral military cooperation
and exchanged views on approaches to implementing joint initiatives in the field of regional and global security.
✅
The priority areas of interdepartmental cooperation
were determined as improving the regulatory framework, training national servicemen and exchanging experience
in the spheres of greatest interest, above all in combating terrorism and piracy.
🤝
The meeting was held in a friendly spirit and confirmed the mutual interest
in strengthening Russian-Somali military ties.

item.title: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, energy infrastructure facilities, as well a
item.description: ❗️ Today, the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continued delivering strikes by unmanned aerial vehicles against logistics centres, energy infrastructure facilities, as well as ships involved in the delivery of military cargo to Ukraine. As a result of the strike, the following targets were hit: ▫️ a logistics centre in Kharkov, where the storage of military and dual-use cargo intended to support the AFU has been organised; ▫️ the PS-330 Lutsk-Severnaya electrical substation in Lutsk and a PS-330 electrical substation in Kovel (Volyn region), which support the operation of defence industry enterprises producing UAVs and their components, as well as logistics centres used for storing military equipment. 💥 In addition, a dry cargo ship delivering cargo intended to support the AFU to the port of Chernomorsk was hit at sea. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🎮 Staying one step ahead Air cover groups of the Vostok Group of Forces destroyed a swarm of AFU hexacopters
item.description: Staying one step ahead 🎮 Air cover groups of the Vostok Group of Forces destroyed a swarm of AFU hexacopters in the Dnepropetrovsk region. 🎯 When a target is detected, the Group's servicemen instantly launch a drone and eliminate the enemy's object. 'Our drones take off, we observe, search, intercept, track, reach, and then the initiation button triggers the self-detonation of our drone and, accordingly, of the enemy drone,' shared the interceptor UAV team leader with the call sign 'Batyr'. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/30328

Staying

item.title: 🚩 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 🚩 In the course of resolute actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces liberated Alisovka (Kharkov region) and Barilovka (Sumy region). 💥 In addition, in Kharkov region, strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Izbitskoye, Stary Saltov, Bugayevka, and Rubezhnoye (Kharkov region). 🔥 In Sumy region, strikes were delivered at formations of one AFU mechanised brigade and one territorial defence brigade near Luzhki and Sukhodol (Sumy region). ▪️ The enemy lost more than 195 troops and six motor vehicles. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line. The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Glushchenkovo, Studenok, Monachinovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region) and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 240 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, one Grad MLRS and six electronic warfare stations. 📍 Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation. The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
🚩
In the course of resolute actions, units of the Sever Group of Forces liberated Alisovka (Kharkov region) and Barilovka (Sumy region).
💥
In addition, in Kharkov region,
strikes were delivered at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, and one assault regiment of the AFU near Izbitskoye, Stary Saltov, Bugayevka, and Rubezhnoye (Kharkov region).
🔥
In Sumy region,
strikes were delivered at formations of one AFU mechanised brigade and one territorial defence brigade near Luzhki and Sukhodol (Sumy region).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 195 troops and six motor vehicles.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces improved the situation along the front line.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one assault brigade of the AFU, and two territorial defence brigades near Glushchenkovo, Studenok, Monachinovka, Smorodkovka (Kharkov region) and Bogorodichnoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 240 troops, an armoured fighting vehicle, 15 motor vehicles, two field artillery guns, one Grad MLRS and six electronic warfare stations.
📍
Units of the Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
Russian elements engaged formations of one mechanised brigade, one air assault brigade of the AFU, and one marine brigade near Semenovka, Slavyansk, Kamyshevakha, and Kramatorsk (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost more than 155 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 31 motor vehicles, and three artillery guns.

🎖
by Russian Defence Ministry on progress of special military operation
as of 28 October 2026
Part 2 (
👉

Part 1
)
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades of the AFU, two marine brigades, and two national guard brigades close to Belozerskoye, Bokovoye, Kalinino, Shilovka, Viktorovka (Donetsk People's Republic), Ivanovka, and Novopavlovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 335 troops, nine armoured fighting vehicles, 10 motor vehicles, and two electronic warfare stations.
↗️
The Vostok Group's units advanced to the depth of the enemy's defence.
They inflicted fire damage on manpower and hardware of two air assault brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one marine brigade close to Berestovoye, Novoukrainka, Tersyanka, and Sergeyevka (Zaporozhye region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 215 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, seven motor vehicles, and one artillery gun.
📍
The Dnepr Group's units improved the situation along the front line.
Formations of one mechanised brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Orekhov and Preobrazhenka (Zaporozhye region).
💥
Up to 20 troops, five motor vehicles, and one electronic warfare station were neutralised.
✈️
Operational-tactical aviation, attack drones, missile troops, and artillery of the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation have inflicted damage
on the power and transport infrastructure facilities used in the interests of the AFU, ammunition depots, production and storage sites of unmanned aerial vehicles, temporary deployment areas of Ukrainian armed forces and foreign mercenaries in 142 areas.
▫️
Air defence systems shot down
two Neptune long-range guided missiles and 617 fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles.
📊
In total,
since the beginning of the special military operation,
the enemy has lost:

674

273,040

tanks and other armoured fighting vehicles,
▫️
1,794
MLRS fighting vehicles,
▫️
36,830
field artillery guns and mortars,
▫️
75,823
support military vehicles.
